name: CS-Eval
description: CS-Eval is a comprehensive bilingual benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on cybersecurity tasks. It includes a diverse set of high-quality questions across 42 cybersecurity categories, organized into three cognitive levels: knowledge, ability, and application.
reputation: Publicly accessible and used to evaluate a wide range of LLMs, revealing insights on model performance and improvements over time.
notes: Bilingual benchmark synthesizing academic and industrial cybersecurity research hotspots.
